solutions.title: DFS components
solutions.strategy: Build adjacency lists and start a traversal from each unvisited node.

timeComplexity.explanation: Every node and edge is visited at most once.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The adjacency list and visited set are stored.

solutions.title: Union-Find
solutions.strategy: Start with n components and decrement the count whenever an edge joins two different sets.

timeComplexity.explanation: Union-Find operations are nearly constant time.

spaceComplexity.explanation: Parent and rank arrays store one entry per node.
